description: Hand labels for the ARKEXA evaluation corpus, used to measure precision and recall of ARKEXA, zizmor and poutine at pinned versions. See ../../METHODOLOGY.md.
claim: On agent-specific issues, what does each scanner find and miss? This corpus is ENRICHED with vulnerable-skewed candidates so there are enough positives to measure recall against. It therefore says nothing whatever about prevalence - use the prevalence corpus.

fields.id: corpus id; the file, repository and commit it maps to are private
fields.triggers: the events declared in the workflow
fields.label: vulnerable | clean
fields.expected_rules: rule ids a correct scanner should report, empty for clean
fields.rationale: the exploit path for vulnerable, the reason it is safe for clean
